name: Ripple Vibe
description: The picture shakes, flares bright and ripples sideways in noisy waves while cutting to the second clip at the midpoint. Recreation of the CapCut "Ripple Vibe" transition. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: duration
params.description: Real transition length in seconds; sets the speed of the shake and of the ripples

params.name: animate
params.description: true (default) = the shake and the ripples move in real time over `duration`. false = like CapCut's export: both stay frozen at their t = 0 position while only the amplitude and the flash change
